meta.name: Airports in India (OurAirports) with AAI passenger traffic FY 2025-26
meta.source_org: OurAirports (public domain); Airports Authority of India (traffic statistics)
meta.license: OurAirports: public domain. AAI traffic: Government of India open statistics.
meta.limitations: Passengers are total (international + domestic) for April 2025 - March 2026 from AAI Annexure III C of the March 2026 traffic report. Only airports that AAI lists (about 148) have a value. Private airports and some JV/PPP airports may not be in the AAI list. Name matching between AAI and OurAirports uses municipality and name and was checked by hand for unmatched names.
meta.method: India rows in OurAirports with type large_airport or medium_airport, or with scheduled_service = yes (small airports and heliports only if scheduled). AAI passengers parsed from the PDF text (pdftotext -layout) and joined by name. Unmatched AAI names are in data/meta/airports.md.
